newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Prasidha to raise $60 mln for expansion.
newsitem.headline: Prasidha to raise $60 mln for expansion.

text.p: Indonesian commodity trading firm PT Prasidha Aneka Niaga said on Monday it planned to raise some $60 million within the next three years for expansion.

Prasidha planned to spend $40 million from the expansion budget to build a citric acid plant as an expansion of its tapioca chips plants, Prasidha financial adviser James Tan told an analysts meeting.
"We are considering to produce (citric) adic to get more value as we already have our tapioca processor plant," Tan said.

Tan said $10 million would be used to finance the company's tuna canning factory in Surabaya, East Java, and the remaining $10 million to finance its expansion into palm oil plantation and crude palm oil production.
He said the company would raise the funds from sources including convertible bonds and rights issue, but did not give further details.
